barbell-bench-press.setup: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar, feet flat, and grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
steps: Unrack the bar and hold it over your mid-chest with straight arms.
Lower the bar under control to your chest, elbows about 45-60 degrees from your body.
Press the bar up and slightly back until your arms are straight.
Re-rack the bar only when your arms are locked out.
cues: Shoulder blades pinched back and down
Feet planted, drive through the floor
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off your chest
Flaring elbows out to 90 degrees
barbell-bench-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

incline-barbell-bench-press.setup: Set an incline bench to 30-45 degrees, lie back with eyes under the bar, and grip just wider than shoulders.
steps: Unrack the bar and hold it over your upper chest with straight arms.
Lower the bar to your upper chest under control, elbows about 45-60 degrees out.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight over your shoulders.
Re-rack the bar only when your arms are locked out.
cues: Keep your back and hips on the bench
Shoulder blades pinched back and down
mistakes: Setting the bench too steep, turning it into a shoulder press
Lifting your hips off the bench
incline-barbell-bench-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

decline-barbell-bench-press.setup: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured under the pads and grip slightly wider than shoulders; use a spotter.
steps: Unrack the bar with a spotter and hold it over your lower chest.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control, elbows about 45 degrees out.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Have your spotter help re-rack the bar before you sit up.
cues: Control the bar all the way down
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off your chest
Skipping the spotter on a decline bench
decline-barbell-bench-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

close-grip-bench-press.setup: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar and hands about shoulder-width apart, just inside a normal grip.
steps: Unrack the bar and hold it over your mid-chest with straight arms.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press the bar up, squeezing your triceps to lock out.
Re-rack the bar only when your arms are locked out.
mistakes: Hands so narrow your wrists bend painfully
Letting the elbows flare wide
close-grip-bench-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

paused-bench-press.setup: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar, feet flat, and grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
steps: Unrack the bar and hold it over your mid-chest with straight arms.
Lower the bar under control until it lightly touches your chest.
Hold the bar still on your chest for a full 1-2 second count.
Press the bar explosively up until your arms are straight.
cues: Do not relax into your chest
mistakes: Sinking or bouncing the bar during the pause
Losing your upper-back tightness
paused-bench-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

floor-press.setup: Lie on the floor with knees bent and feet flat; take the bar from low rack supports or have it handed to you.
steps: Hold the bar over your chest with straight arms and a grip just wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until your upper arms lightly touch the floor.
Pause briefly without relaxing, then press the bar up.
Lock out your arms, then re-rack or set the bar down safely.
cues: Elbows about 45 degrees from your body
Tight upper back on the floor
Press straight up over the shoulders
mistakes: Crashing your elbows into the floor
Flaring elbows wide
floor-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

dumbbell-bench-press.setup: Sit on a flat bench with dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and bring them to chest level.
steps: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight over your chest.
Lower them slowly until your elbows are just below bench level.
Keep elbows about 45-60 degrees from your body.
Press back up, bringing the dumbbells together gently at the top.
mistakes: Clanging the dumbbells together at the top
Lowering too deep and straining the shoulders
dumbbell-bench-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

incline-dumbbell-press.setup: Set a bench to 30-45 degrees, sit with dumbbells on your thighs, and lie back with them at chest level.
steps: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight over your upper chest.
Lower them slowly until your elbows are just below bench level.
Keep elbows about 45-60 degrees from your body.
Press back up without letting the dumbbells drift forward.
mistakes: Setting the incline too steep
Arching your lower back off the bench
incline-dumbbell-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

decline-dumbbell-press.setup: Lie on a decline bench with feet secured, holding dumbbells at chest level; get a helper to hand them over if heavy.
steps: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight over your lower chest.
Lower them slowly until your elbows are just below chest level.
Keep elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up, then lower the dumbbells safely when finished.
cues: Control the weights on the way down
mistakes: Dropping the dumbbells fast at the bottom
Letting wrists bend back
decline-dumbbell-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

neutral-grip-dumbbell-press.setup: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells at chest level, palms facing each other.
steps: Press the dumbbells up with palms facing each other until arms are straight.
Lower slowly, keeping elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Stop when the dumbbells reach the sides of your chest.
Press back up, squeezing your chest and triceps.
cues: Palms face in the whole time
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare out
Bouncing the dumbbells at the bottom
neutral-grip-dumbbell-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

single-arm-dumbbell-bench-press.setup: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell at chest level, free hand across your belly or holding the bench.
steps: Brace your core so your torso does not rotate.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight over your shoulder.
Lower it slowly to chest level with your elbow about 45 degrees out.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
cues: Squeeze your glutes and stay square
mistakes: Twisting or rolling off the bench
Using too heavy a weight to stay balanced
single-arm-dumbbell-bench-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

smith-machine-bench-press.setup: Place a flat bench in the Smith machine so the bar lines up with your mid-chest; set the safety stops.
steps: Lie back, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders, and twist to unhook it.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest under control.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Twist the bar to re-hook it on the rack when done.
cues: Bar path stays over your chest
mistakes: Setting the bench too far forward or back
Forgetting to set safety stops
smith-machine-bench-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

smith-machine-incline-press.setup: Set a bench to 30-45 degrees inside the Smith machine so the bar lowers to your upper chest; set safety stops.
steps: Lie back, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders, and twist to unhook it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest under control.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Twist the bar to re-hook it on the rack when done.
cues: Back and hips stay on the bench
mistakes: Bench too far forward, loading the shoulders
Forgetting to set safety stops
smith-machine-incline-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

machine-chest-press.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your mid-chest, and sit with your back flat against the pad.
steps: Grip the handles and pull your shoulder blades back against the pad.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause, then return slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your feet flat and your head on the pad.
mistakes: Seat set too low or high, straining shoulders
Letting the weight stack crash down
machine-chest-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

incline-machine-press.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height, and sit with your back flat against the pad.
steps: Grip the handles and pull your shoulder blades back against the pad.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your upper chest.
Keep your feet flat and your head on the pad.
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up
Letting the weight stack crash down
incline-machine-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

hammer-strength-decline-press.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles start at lower-chest height, and sit with your back against the pad.
steps: Grip the handles and pull your shoulder blades back against the pad.
Press the handles forward and slightly down until arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your lower chest.
Keep your feet planted throughout.
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up
Letting the handles pull your arms back too far
hammer-strength-decline-press.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you press up.

push-up.setup: Start in a high plank with hands just wider than shoulders and feet hip-width apart.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your body is a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Stop when your chest is just above the floor.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Sagging hips or piking your hips up
Flaring elbows out to 90 degrees
push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you push up.

incline-push-up.setup: Place your hands on a bench or sturdy bar, wider than shoulders, with feet back and body in a straight line.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the bench, elbows about 45 degrees out.
Stop when your chest is just above the bench.
Push away until your arms are straight.
cues: Lower the surface to make it harder
mistakes: Sagging hips
Using a wobbly surface
incline-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you push up.

decline-push-up.setup: Place your feet on a bench with hands on the floor just wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45 degrees out.
Stop when your chest is just above the floor.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Letting your lower back sag
Dropping your head forward
decline-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you push up.

diamond-push-up.setup: Start in a high plank with your hands together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep a straight line.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows brushing your sides.
Stop when your chest is just above your hands.
Push up until your arms are straight.
cues: Elbows stay tight to your ribs
mistakes: Elbows flaring out wide
Wrists or elbows hurting; widen hands slightly
diamond-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you push up.

deficit-push-up.setup: Place each hand on a plate or low block so your chest can lower below hand height; feet hip-width apart.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep a straight line.
Lower your chest below hand level, elbows about 45 degrees out.
Pause briefly at the bottom stretch.
Push up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Dropping too fast into the stretch
Sagging hips at the bottom
deficit-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you push up.

archer-push-up.setup: Start in a wide push-up position with hands about twice shoulder width and feet apart.
steps: Brace your core and shift your weight toward one hand.
Lower your chest toward that hand while the other arm stays straight.
Push back up through the bent arm, keeping the other arm straight.
Alternate sides each rep.
cues: Straight arm acts as a light support
mistakes: Twisting your hips as you shift
Bending the support arm
archer-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you push up.

clap-push-up.setup: Start in a high plank with hands just wider than shoulders on a firm, flat surface.
steps: Brace your core and lower your chest to just above the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Clap quickly, then land with soft, slightly bent elbows.
Reset into a stable plank before the next rep.
mistakes: Landing with locked elbows
Sagging hips when you land
clap-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you explode up.

weighted-chest-dip.setup: Hold the dip bars with a weight belt on and lean your torso forward; start with arms straight and knees bent.
steps: Lean forward about 30 degrees and flare your elbows slightly.
Lower slowly until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press up until your arms are almost straight.
Step down carefully and unclip the weight when done.
cues: Lean forward to hit the chest
mistakes: Dropping too deep and straining the shoulders
Starting with too much added weight
weighted-chest-dip.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you push up.

chest-dip.setup: Hold the dip bars with straight arms, lean your torso forward, and bend your knees so your feet are off the floor.
steps: Lean forward about 30 degrees and flare your elbows slightly.
Lower slowly until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press up until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your chest forward and shoulders down.
cues: Lean forward to hit the chest
mistakes: Dropping too deep and straining the shoulders
Swinging your legs for momentum
chest-dip.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, then breathe out as you push up.

dumbbell-fly.setup: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells over your chest with palms facing each other and a soft bend in your elbows.
steps: Open your arms out wide in an arc, keeping that soft elbow bend.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest, no lower than shoulder level.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back up in the same arc.
Stop with the dumbbells above your chest.
cues: Soft elbow bend, locked in place
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows like a press
Lowering too deep and straining the shoulders
dumbbell-fly.breathing: Breathe in as you open your arms, then breathe out as you bring them together.

incline-dumbbell-fly.setup: Set a bench to 30 degrees and lie back holding dumbbells over your upper chest, palms facing each other, soft elbows.
steps: Open your arms out wide in an arc, keeping that soft elbow bend.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your upper chest.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back up in the same arc.
Stop with the dumbbells above your upper chest.
cues: Soft elbow bend, locked in place
mistakes: Turning the fly into a press
Lowering too deep and straining the shoulders
incline-dumbbell-fly.breathing: Breathe in as you open your arms, then breathe out as you bring them together.

cable-fly-mid.setup: Set both pulleys at chest height, stand in the centre with a staggered stance, and hold a handle in each hand.
steps: Step forward with your chest tall and a soft bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze for a second, then return slowly.
mistakes: Leaning forward and turning it into a press
Using momentum from your body
cable-fly-mid.breathing: Breathe in as you open your arms, then breathe out as you bring them together.

low-to-high-cable-fly.setup: Set both pulleys at the lowest position, stand in the centre with a staggered stance, and hold a handle in each hand.
steps: Lean slightly forward with a soft bend in your elbows.
Sweep your hands up and together to about eye level.
Squeeze your upper chest at the top.
Lower slowly back to hip level with control.
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up
Swinging your torso to lift the weight
low-to-high-cable-fly.breathing: Breathe in as you open your arms, then breathe out as you bring them together.

high-to-low-cable-fly.setup: Set both pulleys at the highest position, stand in the centre with a staggered stance, and hold a handle in each hand.
steps: Lean slightly forward with a soft bend in your elbows.
Sweep your hands down and together to about hip height.
Squeeze your lower chest at the bottom.
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
cues: Pull down in a wide arc
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown
Swinging your torso to lift the weight
high-to-low-cable-fly.breathing: Breathe in as you open your arms, then breathe out as you bring them together.

pec-deck.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height, and sit with your back flat against the pad.
steps: Grip the handles with a soft bend in your elbows and shoulders back.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest for a second.
Return slowly until you feel a gentle chest stretch.
mistakes: Letting the weight pull your arms too far back
Shrugging your shoulders up
pec-deck.breathing: Breathe in as you open your arms, then breathe out as you bring them together.

svend-press.setup: Stand tall holding a weight plate (5-10 kg) between your palms, pressed together at chest height.
steps: Squeeze the plate hard between your palms in front of your chest.
Press it straight out until your arms are extended.
Pause, keeping the squeeze on the plate.
Pull it back to your chest under control.
cues: Elbows slightly bent at the end
mistakes: Letting the plate slip as you press
Leaning back to push the plate
svend-press.breathing: Breathe out as you press the plate forward, in as you return.

dumbbell-pullover.setup: Lie across or along a flat bench with your upper back supported, holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
steps: Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc back behind your head.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in your lats and chest.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest in the same arc.
mistakes: Arching your lower back as you lower
Using a weight that is too heavy
dumbbell-pullover.breathing: Breathe in as the dumbbell goes back, out as you pull it up.

landmine-press.setup: Wedge one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner, stand holding the other end at your shoulder in a split stance.
steps: Hold the bar end at your shoulder with your elbow slightly forward.
Brace your core and press the bar up and forward.
Extend your arm fully without leaning back.
Lower the bar slowly to your shoulder.
mistakes: Leaning back to push the weight up
Using leg drive instead of arm strength
landmine-press.breathing: Breathe out as you press up, in as you lower.

plate-press-out.setup: Stand tall holding a weight plate (5-10 kg) against your chest with both hands.
steps: Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the plate straight out in front of you until your arms are straight.
Hold for a second without letting the plate drop.
Bring the plate back to your chest slowly.
mistakes: Leaning back as you press out
Shrugging your shoulders
plate-press-out.breathing: Breathe out as you press out, in as you return.

scapular-push-up.setup: Start in a high plank with arms straight and hands just wider than shoulders.
steps: Keep your arms straight and brace your core.
Let your chest sink between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades wide.
Pause, then repeat with arms staying straight.
mistakes: Bending your elbows
Sagging your hips
scapular-push-up.breathing: Breathe in as your chest sinks, out as you push away.

conventional-deadlift.setup: Stand with feet hip-width, the bar over mid-foot, and hands just outside your legs.
steps: Hinge down and grip the bar, shins touching it, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and push the floor away as you lift.
Stand tall, hips and knees locking out together.
Reverse the movement and lower the bar to the floor under control.
mistakes: Rounding your lower back
Jerking the bar off the floor
conventional-deadlift.breathing: Brace your core with a big breath in before each pull, then breathe out as you pass the sticking point.

sumo-deadlift.setup: Stand with a wide stance, toes angled out, and the bar over mid-foot; grip with hands inside your knees.
steps: Sit your hips down, grip the bar, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and push the floor apart with your feet.
Stand tall, driving your hips forward to lock out.
Lower the bar under control back to the floor.
cues: Spread the floor with your feet
mistakes: Knees caving inward
Hips shooting up before the bar moves
sumo-deadlift.breathing: Brace your core with a big breath in before each pull, then breathe out as you pass the sticking point.

trap-bar-deadlift.setup: Stand inside a hex bar with feet hip-width apart and grip the handles at your sides.
steps: Hinge down and grip the handles, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and push the floor away with your legs.
Stand tall, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower the bar to the floor under control.
mistakes: Rounding your lower back
Leaning back at the top
trap-bar-deadlift.breathing: Brace your core with a big breath in before each pull, then breathe out as you pass the sticking point.

deficit-deadlift.setup: Stand on a low platform (2-5 cm) with feet hip-width, the bar over mid-foot, and hands just outside your legs.
steps: Hinge down and grip the bar, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and push the floor away as you lift.
Stand tall, hips and knees locking out together.
Lower the bar under control back to the floor.
mistakes: Rounding your back in the deeper start
Using too much weight too soon
deficit-deadlift.breathing: Brace your core with a big breath in before each pull, then breathe out as you pass the sticking point.

rack-pull.setup: Set the bar in a rack at knee height or just below; stand close with feet hip-width and hands outside your legs.
steps: Hinge down and grip the bar, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and pull the bar up along your thighs.
Stand tall, squeezing your glutes and upper back.
Lower the bar under control back to the rack pins.
cues: Squeeze shoulder blades at the top
mistakes: Leaning back at lockout
Dropping the bar onto the pins
rack-pull.breathing: Brace your core with a big breath in before each pull, then breathe out as you pass the sticking point.

barbell-row.setup: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the bar just wider than shoulders.
steps: Hinge until your torso is about 45 degrees and brace your core.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Using body swing to heave the bar
Rounding your lower back
barbell-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

pendlay-row.setup: Stand with feet hip-width over the bar, hinge forward until your torso is near parallel, and grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
steps: Set a flat back with your arms straight and the bar on the floor.
Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Lower it fully back to the floor under control.
Reset your back position before each rep.
cues: Bar returns to floor each rep
mistakes: Standing up as you pull
Rounding your back on reset
pendlay-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

yates-row.setup: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hinge forward to about 60-70 degrees from the floor, back flat.
steps: Brace your core and keep a flat back at a slight forward lean.
Pull the bar toward your lower stomach, elbows close.
Squeeze your lats and shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Elbows stay close to your ribs
mistakes: Heaving with your hips and lower back
Rounding your lower back
yates-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

seal-row.setup: Lie face down on a high bench with a barbell on the floor below you, arms hanging straight, gripping the bar just wider than shoulders.
steps: Keep your chest and stomach pressed against the bench.
Pull the bar up to the underside of the bench.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the bench
Using a bench that is too low
seal-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

t-bar-row.setup: Straddle a landmine bar, hinge forward with a flat back, and grip the handle or V-handle attachment.
steps: Hinge to about 45 degrees and brace your core.
Pull the handle toward your lower chest, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the weight slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Using hip swing to yank the weight
Rounding your lower back
t-bar-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

chest-supported-t-bar-row.setup: Set the pad so your chest rests on it, feet on the platform, and grip the handles with arms straight.
steps: Keep your chest firmly pressed against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad
Shrugging your shoulders up
chest-supported-t-bar-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

single-arm-dumbbell-row.setup: Place one hand and the same-side knee on a bench, other foot on the floor, holding a dumbbell with a flat back.
steps: Let the dumbbell hang with your arm straight and back flat.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back at the top.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
mistakes: Twisting your torso to lift the weight
Pulling to your chest, shrugging up
single-arm-dumbbell-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

chest-supported-dumbbell-row.setup: Lie face down on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms straight.
steps: Keep your chest pressed against the bench.
Pull both dumbbells toward your hips, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the bench
Shrugging your shoulders up
chest-supported-dumbbell-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

meadows-row.setup: Stand side-on to a landmine bar, staggered stance, hinge forward and grip the thick end of the bar with the near hand.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, free hand on your knee for support.
Pull the bar end up toward your hip, elbow high.
Squeeze your lat and shoulder blade at the top.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
mistakes: Twisting your torso to lift
Rounding your lower back
meadows-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

kroc-row.setup: Stand with a split stance, one hand on a bench or rack for support, holding a heavy dumbbell in the other hand.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back and your arm hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip with a slight controlled body movement.
Squeeze your lat at the top.
Lower under control and repeat for high reps.
cues: Use straps if grip limits you
mistakes: Excessive body swing that rounds your back
Using a weight you cannot control
kroc-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

seated-cable-row.setup: Sit at a cable row station with feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and grip the handle with arms straight.
steps: Sit tall with a flat back and your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handle toward your lower stomach, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly without rounding your back.
mistakes: Rocking your torso back and forth
Shrugging your shoulders up
seated-cable-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

wide-grip-cable-row.setup: Sit at a cable row station with a long bar attachment, feet on the platform, gripping the bar wide with arms straight.
steps: Sit tall with a flat back and shoulders relaxed.
Pull the bar toward your upper stomach, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your upper back together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly without rounding your back.
mistakes: Rocking your torso to pull the weight
Shrugging your shoulders up
wide-grip-cable-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

single-arm-cable-row.setup: Sit or stand facing a low cable with a single handle, feet braced, and hold the handle with your arm straight.
steps: Sit tall with a flat back and a braced core.
Pull the handle toward your hip, elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back at the end.
Let your arm extend slowly without twisting.
mistakes: Twisting your torso as you pull
Shrugging your shoulder up
single-arm-cable-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

machine-row.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest, and rest your chest against the pad.
steps: Grip the handles with arms straight and chest on the pad.
Pull the handles toward your body, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Shrugging your shoulders up
Letting the weight stack crash down
machine-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

inverted-row.setup: Set a bar at waist height, lie underneath it, and grip it slightly wider than shoulders with heels on the floor.
steps: Hang with arms straight and body in a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Pull your chest up to the bar, elbows close.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Body stays in a straight line
mistakes: Sagging hips
Not pulling your chest all the way up
inverted-row.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the weight, in as you lower it.

pull-up.setup: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip just wider than shoulders and arms straight.
steps: Pull your shoulder blades down to start the movement.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Squeeze your lats at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
cues: Elbows drive down to your ribs
mistakes: Kipping or swinging for momentum
Not lowering to straight arms
pull-up.breathing: Breathe out as you pull yourself up, in as you lower.

weighted-pull-up.setup: Wear a weight belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet, and hang from a bar with an overhand grip just wider than shoulders.
steps: Pull your shoulder blades down to start the movement.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Squeeze your lats at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
cues: Elbows drive down to your ribs
mistakes: Swinging with the added weight
Adding too much weight too soon
weighted-pull-up.breathing: Breathe out as you pull yourself up, in as you lower.

chin-up.setup: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip at shoulder width and arms straight.
steps: Pull your shoulder blades down to start the movement.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Squeeze your lats and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
mistakes: Kipping or swinging for momentum
Not lowering to straight arms
chin-up.breathing: Breathe out as you pull yourself up, in as you lower.

neutral-grip-pull-up.setup: Hang from parallel handles with palms facing each other and arms straight.
steps: Pull your shoulder blades down to start the movement.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the handles.
Squeeze your lats at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
cues: Elbows drive down to your ribs
mistakes: Kipping or swinging for momentum
Not lowering to straight arms
neutral-grip-pull-up.breathing: Breathe out as you pull yourself up, in as you lower.

assisted-pull-up.setup: Set the assistance weight, kneel or stand on the pad, and grip the handles with an overhand grip.
steps: Pull your shoulder blades down to start the movement.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Squeeze your lats at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
cues: Lower the assist as you get stronger
mistakes: Using too much assistance and bouncing
Not lowering to straight arms
assisted-pull-up.breathing: Breathe out as you pull yourself up, in as you lower.

lat-pulldown.setup: Sit at the pulldown machine, adjust the thigh pad to lock your legs, and grip the bar wider than shoulders.
steps: Sit tall with a slight lean back and your chest up.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Chest up to meet the bar
mistakes: Leaning far back to heave the bar
Pulling the bar behind your neck
lat-pulldown.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the bar down, in as you return.

close-grip-lat-pulldown.setup: Sit at the pulldown machine, lock your thighs under the pad, and grip a close V-handle or narrow bar.
steps: Sit tall with a slight lean back and your chest up.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Chest up to meet the handle
mistakes: Leaning far back to heave the weight
Shrugging your shoulders up
close-grip-lat-pulldown.breathing: Breathe out as you pull the bar down, in as you return.
